violated_contract: A Cloud Run dispatch abort on backend-sync-backfill ('The request was aborted because there was no available instance') must be a first-class, alertable signal. Leaving it as unstructured WARNING/ERROR lines means cold-start instance starvation is invisible until users report stranded backfill.
canonical_prevention: Provision a Cloud Logging metric (sync_backfill_dispatch_abort) and a monitoring policy on the existing sync-backfill-lifecycle budget-alert path, filtered to backend-sync-backfill dispatch aborts, alerting when count > 0, using the same ALERT_CHANNELS as budget alerts in prod. Do not change queue rate limits to paper over missing telemetry.
